label: Sales reports
description: Generated sales and revenue summaries, one per reporting period.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: The date range this report covers.

fields.label: Period start
fields.description: When the period starts (shown in your local time).

fields.label: Period end
fields.description: When the period ends (shown in your local time). Orders from this moment on fall in the next period.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Currency the amounts are reported in.

fields.label: Revenue
fields.description: Total of paid, non-cancelled orders in this period, including shipping and tax, after discounts.

fields.label: Orders
fields.description: Number of paid, non-cancelled orders in this period.

fields.label: Average order value
fields.description: Revenue divided by the number of orders.

fields.label: Items sold
fields.description: Total units across all orders in this period.

fields.label: Subtotal
fields.description: Value of the items ordered, before discounts, shipping and tax.

fields.label: Discounts
fields.description: Total taken off by coupons, promotions and other discounts.

fields.label: Shipping
fields.description: Total shipping charged.

fields.label: Tax
fields.description: Total tax charged.

fields.label: New customers
fields.description: Customers whose first ever paid order was in this period.

fields.label: Returning customers
fields.description: Customers who had already placed a paid order before this period.

fields.label: Revenue change
fields.description: Percentage change in revenue compared with the previous period of equal length.

fields.label: Order change
fields.description: Percentage change in orders compared with the previous period of equal length.

fields.label: Previous revenue
fields.description: Revenue in the period of equal length just before this one.

fields.label: Previous orders
fields.description: Orders in the period of equal length just before this one.

fields.label: Cancelled orders
fields.description: Orders placed in this period that were cancelled. Not counted in revenue.

fields.label: Unpaid orders
fields.description: Orders placed in this period that are not paid yet. Not counted in revenue.

fields.label: Sales report summary
fields.description: Headline figures for this period. Hover the info icon on a figure for what it counts.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.hint: Total of paid, non-cancelled orders in this period, including shipping and tax, after discounts.

rows.label: Previous revenue
rows.hint: Revenue in the period of equal length just before this one.

rows.label: Revenue change

rows.label: Orders
rows.hint: Number of paid, non-cancelled orders in this period.

rows.label: Previous orders

rows.label: Order change
rows.hint: Percentage change in orders compared with the previous period of equal length.

rows.hint: Revenue divided by the number of orders.

fields.label: Top products
fields.description: Best sellers in this period, ranked by revenue, up to 10.

params.empty: No products sold in this period.
params.unlisted_note: This period had more orders than the ranking reads, so the list covers only part of it.

fields.label: Top products partial
fields.description: More paid orders than the ranking reads; the list covers only part of the period.

fields.label: Daily breakdown
fields.description: Orders and revenue for each day in the period.
